api.model_execution: caller only; capture does not construct/open/invoke a model
api.no_model_case: submitted_positions=[]; attach(None); all sidecar scores null
api.sidecar: retained-span-score-capture/v1; rows[].scores, original outcomes/refusals/raw row hashes; complete original runtime report ASCII JSON SHA256
api.source_rows: closed list of {id,source_text}; 1..64 unique occurrence IDs, duplicate source text allowed

implementation_limits: Only explicit already-open model supported; unchanged runtime owns tensor/model/source custody.
Hook metadata and copied score/raw consistency checks are not independent execution attestation.
Existing owner reports are untouched; scores absent in historical reports cannot be recovered from margins.
New numerical diagnostic requires root protocol/resource admission; this build is not admission.
Joint selection changes readout only; no legal accuracy, semantic gold, proof, dimension-family or Lake claim.

coverage: same-output hook returns None and separate deep copies
full heads retained after original early overlap
mandatory/optional complete greedy and original ambiguity stops
one shared callback per submitted physical occurrence and skipped/null rows
temporary hook removal on caller/capture failure
stable row-major ties and float32 threshold arithmetic
test_scope.objects: explicit diagnostic tensor/model doubles; manual callback delivery is not native inference or attestation
